title: dash feed
description: The JSON feed of the build dashboard: the model of tmux_tui_dashboard/model.py as JSON. A project writes this file and starts the three panes with TMUX_TUI_DASHBOARD_SOURCE=json:<path>. Times are ISO 8601 in UTC with a Z. Durations are minutes. Ids are plain strings; the panes compare them and never parse them. A key the model does not know is passed over; a key that is left out takes its default.

milestones.description: In plan order: the order of the columns, the rows and the colours.

tasks.description: In plan order: a task comes after every task it depends on.

edges.description: Every depends-on relation. The depends list of each task adds the edges this list does not name.

usage.description: null when it is not known: the pane then says unknown and never shows an old figure.

locks.description: The locks that are held now.

blockers.description: The open blocker rows, in the order the top pane lists them.

events.description: The stream, oldest first. Keep the newest few hundred; the pane shows each new event once.

time.description: ISO 8601 in UTC, for example 2026-09-20T12:00:00Z; null when not known.

end.description: null while the window is open.

now.description: When the feed was written. The panes draw with their own clock and keep this as the time of the data.

head.description: The commit on the main branch, as the status row shows it.

tags.description: The milestone tags; the status row counts them.

focus.description: The id of the milestone the build works on now. Empty: the first milestone that is not done.

seeded.description: When the plan was first written: the start of `spent` in the middle pane.

gate.description: The newest whole gate: the gate row shows its steps, its verdict, its time and its task.

gates.description: The whole gates of the last 24 hours, oldest first: one cell each on the gate row.

blocker_rows.description: Every blocker row the build has held, open and closed, oldest first, with opened and closed: the row `held` of the chart and the counts of the row `24 h`.

run.description: The run of the driver: its start, and its deadline as the end.

last_activity.description: The newest action of any session: `nothing runs since`.

subject.description: What the gate ran for, a task id.

steps.description: The verdict of each step, in run order: guard, index, ruff, mypy, unit, acceptance, string lint.

purpose.description: One sentence: what the milestone is for.

planned.description: The window its plan gives it: its start, and the start plus its planned minutes.

actual.description: Its first task landed, and its tag (null while it is open).

tasks.description: Its task ids. Empty: the tasks whose milestone is this id.

minutes.description: What its own plan costs with nothing done.

blockers.description: The open blocker rows that hold it.

name.description: The name its box shows, in words. It wraps inside the box and is never cut.

short.description: The name a one-line list shows, often a file name.

wave.description: Its wave in its milestone's own plan with nothing done: the done boxes count finished waves by it.

lane.description: The kind of slot it builds in: the lock lanes of the plan.

elapsed.description: Minutes in flight, used only when started is null.

started.description: When a builder took it; the panes count its elapsed time from this.

merged.description: When it landed: the done frontier of the graph shows the newest first; the estimate counts the merges of the last 72 hours for the merge rate.

added.description: When its row entered the plan: the burn-up rows of its milestone count the rows it held at each day.

why.description: Why it is where it is. Shown in its box in place of the reason the panes derive.

review.description: A review row: its lane shows as main.

target.description: The task that waits for it.

role.description: orchestrator, healer or walker for a session that runs; `heal cycle` for a past healer run; `builder`, `merge` and `review` for the runs of a task (the note names it): the hours column of the chart and its last 12 hours.

window.description: Where a person can watch it.

outcome.description: How a past run ended: done, blocked, none.

note.description: A short fact, such as 2/3 for the second of three heal cycles.

last.description: Its last sign of life: the time of its newest action.

reset_at.description: When it resets, as a time.

rate.description: Per cent an hour, measured; null until it is measured.

full.description: When it reaches 100 per cent at that rate: orange when that comes before its reset.

name.description: A lock whose name starts with main is the main lock of the status row.

holder.description: Who holds it, in words: merge of t21.

lane.description: The lane of a slot: the status row counts the slots of each lane.

live.description: False when the process that holds it is gone: drawn gone, counted nowhere.

task.description: The task it holds; empty when it names none.

kind.description: Its class: a, b, c, or ?.

since.description: The date it was opened, as written.

opened.description: The commit that added the row: the age on the border of the box it holds.

closed.description: The commit that took the row away; null while it is open.

milestone.description: The milestone whose run holds the wave.

paced.description: At the pace measured on this build.

waves.description: The open waves of each open milestone, in the order they run.

critical.description: The tasks on the critical path to each open milestone's tag.

projected.description: Milestone id to its projected window, for each milestone that is not done.

finish.description: The projected finish of every open task.

builder_n.description: How many builder runs the figure is measured on; 0: the planner's own term.

lanes.description: Lane to its slots, in the order the status row shows them.

builder_samples.description: The minutes of each measured builder run: the estimate shows their p25 and p75.

schedule.description: Task id to its projected window: the start of its build and its landing. A wave's window is the first start and the last landing of its open tasks; a milestone's tag and the finish are the last landing of theirs.

spread.description: Milestone id to the window its tag falls in: its tag at the p25 and at the p75 builder minutes. Empty with fewer than two samples.

finish_spread.description: The finish of every open task at the p25 and at the p75 builder minutes: the range the estimate row shows.

stages.description: Stage to the screens spent there.

last.description: The last screen: its stage and heading.

verdict.description: PASS, FAIL, or empty when the walk gave none.

time.description: ISO 8601 UTC; empty takes the minute the pane reads it.

source.description: Who did it; the first word picks the colour: driver, orchestrator, builder, healer, walker, merge.

kind.description: log, says, result, prompt, heartbeat, error, reset (the pane starts a new backlog), divider (a rule of ═: a wave recorded, a tag), or a tool name.

outcome.description: For a tool call with its result: ok, failed or timed out, drawn first as ✔, ✖ or the words. A tool event with no outcome and no result is a call in flight: the pinned row under the stream shows it.

result.description: The first line of that result, drawn in grey after the call.
